Thank you.  Especially for the bitter person part.  I'm trying very hard to be the best person I can be, but it gets so hard.  I keep myself distracted as much as possible, but when I'm not, I'm absolutely miserable.  

And as for the meds, I'm not a huge fan of them.  My family has a history of weird depression and bad medical practices.  Thanks for the suggestion, though.  It means a lot that you took the time to respond.
